t: A Wi-Fi chip with built-in USB, loved by CircuitPython fans.
steps: Buy an Adafruit ESP32-S2 Feather or QT Py, or a SparkFun or Olimex S2 board.
Download CircuitPython for your board from the CircuitPython website.
Follow the board page steps to load the firmware over USB.
Open code.py on the CIRCUITPY drive and try the blink example.
Add your Wi-Fi name and password to the settings file.
Try the Wi-Fi test example from the Adafruit guide.
Plug in a sensor with a STEMMA QT cable and print its readings.
meta: Open Board. From $8. A few stores.
